Cost: 5,000eb (Luxury)
Class: Excellent Quality Machine Gun
Range: N/A
Pre-installed: Power Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (Machine Gun 5), Suppressive Fire

Autofire and Suppressive Fire only, each using 20 rounds. An Autofire attack that beats the DV by only 1 still gets x2. Reloading takes 3 Reload Actions. Needs BODY 11+ to wield unless mounted; without BODY 13+ the wielder takes -2 MOVE. A Nomad may take this weapon when first installing a Vehicle Heavy Weapon Mount.

Foundry notes:

  • Autofire and Suppressive Fire only; 2d6 is the standard Autofire damage.
  • Autofire only, so its DV table is the Autofire table.
  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
